_comment: Civic Education Methods -- Secondary Teachers' Diploma syllabus, Years 1-2.
THEME. The file name carries no SYLLABUS, TED or VALIDATED, so "theme": "gensyl" is set here.
LEVEL / YEAR. Secondary Teachers' Diploma; 2025 as on the copyright line (the manuscript's cover
says 2023). The manuscript also carries leftover cover text from other syllabuses (Design &
Technology, Technology Studies); the cover and title page are drawn from the theme, so none prints.
MATRIX NUMBERS. renumberMatrix: the topics run 1.3, 1.3, 1.5, 1.6, 1.6, 1.9 and two sub-topics are
numbered only '1.'. Counted afresh, Year 1 has 9 topics (1.1-1.9, as in the typed contents list)
and Year 2 three (2.1 School Experience, 2.2 School Experience Review, 2.3 Record Management).
YEAR PAGES. YEAR 1 / YEAR 2 are typed over each year's Key Competences; the engine moves each below
the competences, over its matrix. Year 2's competences had YEAR 2 merged across the top of the
table and no heading: KEY COMPETENCES is added and the table opens a fresh page, as in Year 1.
AUTHOR QUERIES (left as typed), Year 2 Key Competences:
- 'Creativity and Innovation' and 'Critical Thinking' each appear twice. The second Creativity and
Innovation row reads like Entrepreneurship / Environmental Sustainability; the second Critical
Thinking row (gender stereotypes, child abuse, institutions of gender, development policies)
matches Civic Education CONTENT topics, not Methods.
- Financial Literacy ends in a cut-off line: 'Developing s'.

insertHead._why: Year 2 competences carry no KEY COMPETENCES heading (Year 1 does); the manuscript only merged YEAR 2 across the top of the table.
insertHead.head: KEY COMPETENCES

pageBreakBefore._why: The Assessment section split with its '1. College-Based Assessment' heading alone at the foot of a page; it opens the next page whole.

pageBreakBefore._why: Year 2 competences open a fresh page, as Year 1 does, instead of starting under the last Year 1 matrix row.
